descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: another physician's patients.

Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S12 Existing specs: the queries behind the dashboard never return another physician's patients

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Demo physician and a second physician, each with patients whose names, MRNs and diagnoses match

When Page through listPage (the query the dashboard reads) and read listCounts in each care setting

Then The other physician's matching row is never returned. Totals move only with the owner's own adds and removes. In Nursing Home, 'today' counts only In Today rows

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright api assertions. Server level only: the dashboard screen is judged in S03, S04a/S04b and S13. Also evidence that the server already keeps an In Today count (listCounts.today) that the Nursing Home dashboard does not use

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
